task.payload: {"metadata":{"description":"Everything renders: images, video, audio, PDF, Office documents and local web pages inline in the DeepSeek Harness web UI, via a display_file tool.","id":"gh:1352103164","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-viewer","slug":"Crosery/dsh-viewer","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","office","pdf","viewer"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Everything renders: images, video, audio, PDF, Office documents and local web pages inline in the De"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"epSeek Harness web UI, via a display_file tool."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# @crosery/dsh-viewer"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**Everything renders.** One `display_file` tool that puts images, video, audio, PDF, Office document"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"s and local web pages inline in the DeepSeek Harness conversation, on the web and in the desktop app"},{"id":"p3s3","text":" — with a real player, not a filename and a byte count."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"English · 中文 · MIT"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"The harness ships `read_image`, whose job is to put a picture into **model context**. It refuses on "},{"id":"p6s2","text":"a text-only route, it handles four raster formats, and up to harness 0.1.2 the built-in web client d"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"raws no card for it — so the human in front of the screen sees one line of text. (From 0.1.3 the har"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"ness draws its own `read_image` view, and this plugin's card for that key steps aside.)"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"This plugin inverts that. Its job is to put a file **on your screen**. A text-only model route is a "},{"id":"p7s2","text":"normal outcome, not a refusal, and every medium a browser can play is in scope."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"**36 file extensions across 6 render kinds:**"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| Kind | Element | Extensions |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| Image | `` + click-to-zoom lightbox | `png` `jpg` `jpeg` `webp` `gif` `svg` `avif` `bmp` `ico"},{"id":"p10s2","text":" click-to-zoom lightbox | `png` `jpg` `jpeg` `webp` `gif` `svg` `avif` `bmp` `ico` `apng` | [该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Security"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"The route **never accepts a path from the browser.** At tool time the host signs the resolved absolu"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"te path with a per-harness HMAC key; path and MAC travel together in the URL, and the route honours "},{"id":"p12s3","text":"a path only after the MAC verifies."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- Key: 32 random bytes at `$DSH_HOME/.dsh-viewer-asset-key`, mode `0600`, generated on first use. A "},{"id":"p13s2","text":"self-contained signature rather than an in-process token table, because cards must survive a restart"},{"id":"p13s3","text":" — a card replayed from a months-old session log holds only the URL it was minted with. The one exce"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"ption is a converted document: its URL names a cached PDF, and once that has been evicted the card's"},{"id":"p13s5","text":" frame answers `404` until `display_file` converts the file again. - Tampering with the path, swappi"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"ng keys, dropping the signature, or re-spelling the base64 with padding all return `404`. "Not signe"},{"id":"p13s7","text":"d by us" and "signed but the file is gone" return the *same* status, so a probe cannot learn whether"},{"id":"p13s8","text":" a file exists. - `text/html` and `image/svg+xml` ship with a `Content-Security-Policy` (`sandbox` a"},{"id":"p13s9","text":"nd `default-src 'none'` respectively): navigating directly to such an asset would otherwise run its "},{"id":"p13s10","text":"script on the app's origin. Everything carries `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`. - Bytes stream wit"},{"id":"p13s11","text":"h `createReadStream`, not `ctx.fs.readBytes` — the latter materializes the whole file in memory, and"},{"id":"p13s12","text":" a two-hour video is precisely the case this plugin exists for."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Harness compatibility"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"| Where | Versions | Evidence |"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| Web (`dsh --profile web`) | every published version, `0.0.1-rc.1` through `0.2.2-rc.1` — npm `late"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"st` (`0.2.1-rc.5`), `next` (`0.2.2-rc.1`) and `alpha` (`0.2.2-alpha.3`) included. `0.0.1-rc.1` and `"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"rc.2` are admitted, but their own harness cannot be installed by anyone | historical sweeps and smok"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"e records cover the earlier versions (see the acceptance record); for this update, both typechecks, "},{"id":"p16s5","text":"209/209 tests and a strict nine-stage smoke passed on each of `0.2.1-rc.5` and `0.2.2-alpha.2` on 20"},{"id":"p16s6","text":"26-11-01 UTC. CI's weekly sweep and the release gate cover all 40 installable versions; live card ch"},{"id":"p16s7","text":"ecks in a browser cover `0.0.1-rc.5`, `0.1.0-rc.2`, `0.1.0-rc.6`, `0.1.7-rc.2` and `0.2.1-alpha.1` ("},{"id":"p16s8","text":"v0.1.1 also on `0.1.1-rc.2` and `0.1.5-rc.2`) | | Desktop app | current `nightly` feed: `0.2.1-rc.5`"},{"id":"p16s9","text":" (released 2026-10-29) | strict smoke of the matching npm Web runtime passed; the current desktop by"},{"id":"p16s10","text":"tes await the release gate. Historical desktop runtime smoke and live macOS window checks: `0.1.7-rc"},{"id":"p16s11","text":"wait the release gate. Historical desktop runtime smoke and live macOS window checks: `0.1.7-rc.2` |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"The peer ranges admit exactly that support, one comparator set per tuple, under npm's semver rule an"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"d under the prerelease-inclusive rule the harness applies itself from 0.1.7. The trains before `0.1."},{"id":"p17s3","text":"0-rc.8` have an older front end without `dsh-client-ui-renderer`; the plugin needs only the `slots` "},{"id":"p17s4","text":"and `locale` services from it, which every train has. Unverified tuples such as `0.1.8` and `0.2.3` "},{"id":"p17s5","text":"are admitted once CI has verified them."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"CI keeps the claim honest. Every pull request runs typecheck, tests, peer admission and a real boot "},{"id":"p18s2","text":"of the packed plugin, run in headless Chrome, on the pinned train, on the `0.1.1-rc.2` floor and on "},{"id":"p18s3","text":"whatever the desktop app ships that day. A daily job repeats that against the desktop app and npm's "},{"id":"p18s4","text":"`latest`, `next` and `alpha`, and against the desktop zip itself on macOS. A weekly job sweeps every"},{"id":"p18s5","text":" published harness version and boots and runs the plugin on every one that installs, so a new one sh"},{"id":"p18s6","text":"ows up without anyone adding it. A failure opens an `upstream-drift` issue, and the first green run "},{"id":"p18s7","text":"closes it. Releases are gated on the same checks. Details: docs/harness-compatibility.md."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"- Local file paths only; URLs are not accepted. - Video and audio duration/resolution are not in the"},{"id":"p20s2","text":" card header — that needs `ffprobe`. The player shows them. - Where the plugin reads an attachment-o"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"nly image itself (up to 0.1.5), the object URL lives until the plugin unloads, bounding held blobs b"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"y the distinct attachments displayed meanwhile.
